        assert_eq!(original_hash.as_slice(), &expected[29..61]);
        assert_eq!(case == 5, original_hash != super::MINIMAL_INTENT_DIGEST);
    }
    for guard in [None, Some(0), Some(u64::MAX)] {
        let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
        if let Some(value) = guard {
            let mut payload = vec![1];
            payload.extend_from_slice(&value.to_be_bytes());
            drop(intent.splice(35..36, payload));
        }
        let stamp = CommittedTime::new(HlcTimestamp::new(0, 0)?, 0)?;
        let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"], stamp)?;
        let (caller, bytes, frame) = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame_caller(
            super::input(minimal_data(), guard)?,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(caller.input().expected_generation(), guard);
        assert!(caller.input().data() == &minimal_data());
        assert!(caller.schema_limits() == limits);
        assert_eq!(caller.admission_limits(), AdmissionLimits::default());
        assert_eq!((bytes, frame), (intent.len(), expected.len()));
        let prepared = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            super::input(minimal_data(), guard)?,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
        assert_eq!(
            prepared.digest(),
            PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(&expected).into())
        );
        assert_eq!(&prepared.as_bytes()[83..], intent);
    }
    assert_eq!(
        ClientIntent::new(2, [0; 32]),
        Err(RequestValueError::UnsupportedVersion)
    );
    Ok(())
}

fn complete_replace_frame_enforces_whole_scope_raw_count_and_list_canonicality_priority()

    let wrong = profile(1_000_000_001)?;
    let before = (charge.g(), charge.p());

        CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch
        ))
    );
    let result = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
        &expected,
        wrong,
        AdmissionLimits::default(),
        &mut charge,
    );

        result.err().ok_or("profile verifier refusal")?,
        CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch
        ))
    );
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), before);
    for maximum in [134, 135] {

            );
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 1_543);

}

        let expected = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[0].0)?;
        let result = if producer {

                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|_| ())
        } else {
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &expected,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|_| ())
        };
        assert_eq!(
            result,
            Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(
                CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                    bytes: target,
                    maximum
                })
            ))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
            (retained, 0, retained)
        );
    }
    let limits = profile(1_543)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
        super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
        limits,
        AdmissionLimits::new(1_048_576, 134, 1_000)?,
        &mut charge,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        result.err().ok_or("F cap before Q")?,
        CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit)
    );
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (1_543, 0));
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_hex(hex: &str) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    for pair in hex.as_bytes().as_chunks::<2>().0 {
        bytes.push(u8::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(pair)?, 16)?);
    }
    assert_eq!(bytes.len() * 2, hex.len());
    Ok(bytes)
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_input(
    data: CompletePolicyData,
    guard: Option<u64>,
    ids: [&[u8]; 4],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
) -> TestResult<CompletePolicyReplaceInput> {
    Ok(CompletePolicyReplaceInput::new(
        RequestScope::new(
            TenantId::new(ids[0].to_vec())?,
            GroupId::new(ids[1].to_vec())?,
            RecoveryId::new(ids[2].to_vec())?,
        ),
        RequestId::new(ids[3].to_vec())?,
        stamp,
        guard,
        data,
    ))
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_literal(
    intent: &[u8],
    ids: [&[u8]; 4],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut expected = b"FWCP\0\x01\x06".to_vec();
    for id in ids {
        expected.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(id.len())?.to_be_bytes());
        expected.extend_from_slice(id);
    }
    expected.extend_from_slice(b"\0\x02");
    expected.extend_from_slice(&<[u8; 32]>::from(Sha256::digest(intent)));
    expected.extend_from_slice(&stamp.hlc().physical().get().to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&stamp.hlc().logical().to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&stamp.wall().get().to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(intent.len())?.to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(intent);
    Ok(expected)
}

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_verified(
    verified: &VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'_>,
    expected: &[u8],
    log: LogIdentity,
) {
    let mut cursor = 7;
    let mut ids = Vec::new();
    let mut scope = b"FWSC\0\x01".to_vec();
    for index in 0..4 {
        assert_eq!(&expected[cursor..cursor + 2], &[0, 0]);
        let length = usize::from(u16::from_be_bytes(
            expected[cursor + 2..cursor + 4].as_chunks::<2>().0[0],
        ));
        if index < 3 {
            scope.extend_from_slice(&expected[cursor..cursor + 4]);
        }
        cursor += 4;
        ids.push(&expected[cursor..cursor + length]);
        if index < 3 {
            scope.extend_from_slice(ids[index]);
        }
        cursor += length;
    }
    let original = &expected[cursor + 56..];
    let digest = PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(expected).into());
    let intent: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(original).into();
    let physical = u64::from_be_bytes(expected[cursor + 34..cursor + 42].as_chunks::<8>().0[0]);
    let logical = u16::from_be_bytes(expected[cursor + 42..cursor + 44].as_chunks::<2>().0[0]);
    let wall = u64::from_be_bytes(expected[cursor + 44..cursor + 52].as_chunks::<8>().0[0]);
    let header = verified.header(log);
    assert_eq!(verified.encoded(), expected);
    assert_eq!(verified.original_intent(), original);
    assert_eq!(verified.digest(), digest);
    assert_eq!(verified.isolation_scope(), scope);
    assert_eq!(header.format_version, 1);
    assert_eq!(header.scope.tenant().as_bytes(), ids[0]);
    assert_eq!(header.scope.group().as_bytes(), ids[1]);
    assert_eq!(header.scope.recovery().as_bytes(), ids[2]);
    assert_eq!(header.request.as_bytes(), ids[3]);
    assert_eq!(header.intent.version(), 2);
    assert_eq!(*header.intent.digest(), intent);
    assert_eq!(header.stamp.hlc().physical().get(), physical);
    assert_eq!(header.stamp.hlc().logical(), logical);
    assert_eq!(header.stamp.wall().get(), wall);
    assert_eq!(header.identity, EntryIdentity::new(log, digest));
    assert_eq!(header.encoded_entry, expected);
    assert_eq!(header.encoded_isolation_scope, scope);
}

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_account(
    maximum: u64,
    producer: bool,
    repeated: bool,
    held_peak: bool,
) -> TestResult {
    let limits = profile(maximum)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    let mut seed_data = minimal_data();
    seed_data.indexed_attributes = Some(vec![b"a".to_vec()]);
    let seed = if held_peak {
        Some(restore_complete_policy(1, seed_data, limits, &mut charge)?)
    } else {
        None
    };
    let expected = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    let mut produced = Vec::new();
    let mut verified = Vec::new();
    let fee = if producer { 4_612 } else { 4_423 };
    let attempts = if repeated { 2 } else { 1 };
    let initial = if held_peak { 1_928 } else { 0 };
    let peak = if held_peak { 64 } else { 0 };
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (initial, peak));
    for attempt in 1..=attempts {
        let target = initial + fee * attempt + peak;
        let result = if producer {
            prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                super::super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|value| produced.push(value))
        } else {
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &expected,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|value| verified.push(value))
        };
        if maximum < target {
            assert_eq!(
                result,
                Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(
                    CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                        bytes: target,
                        maximum
                    })
                ))
            );
            assert_eq!(
                (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
                (target - peak - 263, peak, target - 263)
            );
        } else {
            result?;
            assert_eq!(
                (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
                (target - peak, peak, target)
            );
        }
    }
    for value in &produced {
        assert_eq!(value.as_bytes(), expected);
        assert_eq!(
            value.digest(),
            PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(&expected).into())
        );
    }
    for value in &verified {
        assert_replace_frame_verified(
            value,
            &expected,
            LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
        );
    }
    if let Some(seed) = seed {
        let mut expected = minimal_data();
        expected.indexed_attributes = Some(vec![b"a".to_vec()]);
        assert!(seed.data() == &expected);
        assert_eq!(seed.generation(), 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(charge.p(), peak);
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_boundary(
    case: usize,
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let stamp = CommittedTime::new(HlcTimestamp::new(0, 0)?, 0)?;
    if case == 0 {
        for length in [8_172, 8_173] {
            let tenant = vec![b't'; length];
            let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
            let mut raw = u32::try_from(length)?.to_be_bytes().to_vec();
            raw.extend_from_slice(&tenant);
            drop(intent.splice(30..35, raw));
            let ids = [&tenant[..], b"g", b"r", b"q"];
            let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, ids, stamp)?;
            let before = charge.g();
            let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                replace_frame_input(minimal_data(), None, ids, stamp)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge,
            );
            if length == 8_173 {
                assert_eq!(
                    result.err().ok_or("scope +1 producer")?,
                    CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit
                );
                assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 128);
                let before = charge.g();
                assert_eq!(
                    verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                        &expected,
                        limits,
                        AdmissionLimits::default(),
                        charge
                    )
                    .err()
                    .ok_or("scope +1 verifier")?,
                    CompletePolicyRequestError::ScopeLimit
                );
                assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 8_706);
            } else {
                let prepared = result?;
                assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
                assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 86_322);
                let before = charge.g();
                let verified = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    prepared.as_bytes(),
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge,
                )?;
                assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 94_304);
                assert_replace_frame_verified(
                    &verified,
                    &expected,
                    LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
                );
            }
        }
    } else if case == 1 {
        for count in [
            limits.policy_limits().max_states(),
            limits.policy_limits().max_states() + 1,
        ] {
            let mut data = minimal_data();
            let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
            intent[45..49].copy_from_slice(&u32::try_from(count)?.to_be_bytes());
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            for name in 0..count {
                let key = u16::try_from(name)?.to_be_bytes().to_vec();
                data.states.insert(
                    key.clone(),
                    CompleteStatePolicyData {
                        mode: None,
                        retry: None,
                        retention: None,
                        governance: None,
                    },
                );
                entries.extend_from_slice(b"\0\0\0\x02");
                entries.extend_from_slice(&key);
                entries.extend_from_slice(&[0; 4]);
            }
            drop(intent.splice(49..49, entries));
            let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"], stamp)?;
            let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                super::super::input(data, None)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge,
            );
            if count > limits.policy_limits().max_states() {
                assert_eq!(
                    result.err().ok_or("state count +1")?,
                    CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ItemLimit)
                );
            } else {
                let prepared = result?;
                assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
                let verified = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    prepared.as_bytes(),
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge,
                )?;
                assert_replace_frame_verified(
                    &verified,
                    &expected,
                    LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
                );
            }
        }
    } else if case == 2 {
        for count in [3, 4] {
            let mut data = minimal_data();
            let mut wire = vec![1];
            wire.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(count)?.to_be_bytes());
            let mut names = Vec::new();
            for name in 0..count {
                let key = u8::try_from(name)?.to_be_bytes().to_vec();
                wire.extend_from_slice(b"\0\0\0\x01");
                wire.extend_from_slice(&key);
                names.push(key);
            }
            data.indexed_attributes = Some(names);
            let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
            drop(intent.splice(49..50, wire));
            let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"], stamp)?;
            let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                super::super::input(data, None)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge,
            );
            if count == 4 {
                assert_eq!(
                    result.err().ok_or("indexed count +1")?,
                    CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ItemLimit)
                );
            } else {
                let prepared = result?;
                assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
                let verified = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    prepared.as_bytes(),
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge,
                )?;
                assert_replace_frame_verified(
                    &verified,
                    &expected,
                    LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
                );
            }
        }
    } else if case == 3 {
        for length in [262_060, 262_061] {
            let mut data = minimal_data();
            let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
            intent[45..49].copy_from_slice(&4_u32.to_be_bytes());
            let mut entries = Vec::new();
            for first in 0..4 {
                let count = if first == 3 { length } else { 262_144 };
                let mut key = vec![0; count];
                key[0] = first;
                entries.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(count)?.to_be_bytes());
                entries.extend_from_slice(&key);
                entries.extend_from_slice(&[0; 4]);
                data.states.insert(
                    key,
                    CompleteStatePolicyData {
                        mode: None,
                        retry: None,
                        retention: None,
                        governance: None,
                    },
                );
            }
            drop(intent.splice(49..49, entries));
            let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"], stamp)?;
            let before = charge.g();
            let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                super::super::input(data, None)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge,
            );
            if length == 262_061 {
                assert_eq!(
                    result.err().ok_or("whole intent +1")?,
                    CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit)
                );
                assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 1_050_240);
            } else {
                let prepared = result?;
                assert_eq!(intent.len(), 1_048_576);
                assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
                assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 6_299_340);
                let verified = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    prepared.as_bytes(),
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge,
                )?;
                assert_replace_frame_verified(
                    &verified,
                    &expected,
                    LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
                );
            }
        }
    } else if case == 4 {
        let minimum = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[0].0)?;
        for end in 0..minimum.len() {
            assert!(
                verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    &minimum[..end],
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge
                )
                .is_err()
            );
        }
        for (offset, value, error) in [
            (0, b'X', CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed),
            (5, 2, CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion),
            (6, 5, CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
            (28, 1, CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion),
            (83, b'X', CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed),
            (118, 2, CompletePolicyEncodingError::InvalidOptionality),
            (124, 2, CompletePolicyEncodingError::InvalidOptionality),
        ] {
            let mut bytes = minimum.clone();
            bytes[offset] = value;
            assert_eq!(
                verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    &bytes,
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge
                )
                .err()
                .ok_or("malformed mutation")?,
                CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(error)
            );
        }
        let mut bytes = minimum.clone();
        bytes.push(0);
        assert_eq!(
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &bytes,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge
            )
            .err()
            .ok_or("trailing frame")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::TrailingBytes)
        );
        let mut bytes = minimum.clone();
        bytes[34 + 83] = b'u';
        assert_eq!(
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &bytes,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge
            )
            .err()
            .ok_or("tenant mismatch")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)
        );
        let mut bytes = minimum.clone();
        bytes[29] ^= 1;
        assert_eq!(
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &bytes,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge
            )
            .err()
            .ok_or("digest mismatch")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::EncodingMismatch)
        );
        let mut full = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[1].0)?;
        for (offset, value) in [
            (42, 2),
            (65, 4),
            (114, 2),
            (165, 3),
            (188, 2),
            (193, 3),
            (213, 2),
        ] {
            let previous = full[83 + offset];
            full[83 + offset] = value;
            assert!(
                verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                    &full,
                    limits,
                    AdmissionLimits::default(),
                    charge
                )
                .is_err()
            );
            full[83 + offset] = previous;
        }
    } else {
        return Err("unknown independent boundary case".into());
    }
    Ok(())
}

    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    for (case, (hex, hash)) in FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES.iter().enumerate() {
        let expected = replace_frame_hex(hex)?;
        let digest: [u8; 32] = replace_frame_hex(hash)?
            .try_into()
            .map_err(|_| "fixed digest width")?;
        let original = if case == 0 {
            MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES
        } else {
            PRESENT_INTENT_BYTES
        };
        let data = if case == 0 {
            minimal_data()
        } else {
            present_data()
        };
        assert_eq!(&expected[83..], original);
        assert_eq!(<[u8; 32]>::from(Sha256::digest(&expected)), digest);
        let input = super::input(data, None)?;
        let before = charge.g();
        let prepared = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            input,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
        assert_eq!(prepared.digest(), PreparedDigest::new(digest));
        let (producer, verifier, peak) = if case == 0 {
            (4_612, 4_423, 0)
        } else {
            (47_249, 22_427, 128)
        };
        assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (before + producer, peak));
        let verified = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            prepared.as_bytes(),
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(
            (charge.g(), charge.p()),
            (before + producer + verifier, peak)
        );
        assert_replace_frame_verified(
            &verified,
            &expected,
            LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
        );
        assert_eq!(verified.encoded().as_ptr(), prepared.as_bytes().as_ptr());
        assert_eq!(
            verified.original_intent().as_ptr(),
            prepared.as_bytes()[83..].as_ptr()
        );
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[test]
fn complete_replace_frame_binds_header_operands_without_binding_assigned_generation() -> TestResult
{
    let limits = profile(100_000_000)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    let first = prepare_complete_policy_value_v2(
        restore_complete_policy(1, minimal_data(), limits, &mut charge)?,
        limits,
        &mut charge,
    )?;
    let later = prepare_complete_policy_value_v2(
        restore_complete_policy(9, minimal_data(), limits, &mut charge)?,
        limits,
        &mut charge,
    )?;
    let mut expected_value = replace_frame_hex(
        "46575056000200000000000000010000001646575053000200000001720000000000000000000000",
    )?;
    assert_eq!(first.encoded(), expected_value);
    expected_value[6..14].copy_from_slice(&9_u64.to_be_bytes());
    assert_eq!(later.encoded(), expected_value);
    assert!(first.data() == later.data());
    assert_eq!((first.generation(), later.generation()), (1, 9));
    for (case, ids) in [*b"tgrq", *b"tGrq", *b"tgRq", *b"tgrQ", *b"tgrq", *b"ugrq"]
        .into_iter()
        .enumerate()
    {
        let stamp = if case == 4 {
            CommittedTime::new(HlcTimestamp::new(99, 7)?, 98)?
        } else {
            CommittedTime::new(HlcTimestamp::new(0, 0)?, 0)?
        };
        let ids = [&ids[0..1], &ids[1..2], &ids[2..3], &ids[3..4]];
        let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
        intent[34] = ids[0][0];
        let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, ids, stamp)?;
        let prepared = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            replace_frame_input(minimal_data(), None, ids, stamp)?,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
        let verified = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            prepared.as_bytes(),
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        for log in [
            LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
            LogIdentity::new(9, 8, AppliedPosition::new(7)),
        ] {
            assert_replace_frame_verified(&verified, &expected, log);
        }
        let original_hash: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(&intent).into();
        assert_eq!(original_hash.as_slice(), &expected[29..61]);
        assert_eq!(case == 5, original_hash != super::MINIMAL_INTENT_DIGEST);
    }
    for guard in [None, Some(0), Some(u64::MAX)] {
        let mut intent = MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
        if let Some(value) = guard {
            let mut payload = vec![1];
            payload.extend_from_slice(&value.to_be_bytes());
            drop(intent.splice(35..36, payload));
        }
        let stamp = CommittedTime::new(HlcTimestamp::new(0, 0)?, 0)?;
        let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"], stamp)?;
        let (caller, bytes, frame) = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame_caller(
            super::input(minimal_data(), guard)?,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(caller.input().expected_generation(), guard);
        assert!(caller.input().data() == &minimal_data());
        assert!(caller.schema_limits() == limits);
        assert_eq!(caller.admission_limits(), AdmissionLimits::default());
        assert_eq!((bytes, frame), (intent.len(), expected.len()));
        let prepared = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            super::input(minimal_data(), guard)?,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            &mut charge,
        )?;
        assert_eq!(prepared.as_bytes(), expected);
        assert_eq!(
            prepared.digest(),
            PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(&expected).into())
        );
        assert_eq!(&prepared.as_bytes()[83..], intent);
    }
    assert_eq!(
        ClientIntent::new(2, [0; 32]),
        Err(RequestValueError::UnsupportedVersion)
    );
    Ok(())
}

        (89, 104, &[1, 0, 0][..]),
        (163, 394, &[1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0][..]),
    ]
    .into_iter()
    .enumerate()
    {
        let mut held = Vec::new();
        for present in [false, true] {
            let mut intent = PRESENT_INTENT_BYTES.to_vec();
            let payload = if present { empty } else { &[0][..] };
            drop(intent.splice(start..end, payload.iter().copied()));
            let expected = replace_frame_literal(&intent, [b"t", b"g", b"r", b"q"], stamp)?;
            let mut data = present_data();
            replace_frame_empty_field(&mut data, case, present)?;

            held.push(prepared);

#[test]
fn complete_replace_frame_enforces_whole_scope_raw_count_and_list_canonicality_priority()
-> TestResult {
    let limits = PolicySchemaLimits::new(PolicyLimits::new(4)?, 1_000_000_000)?;
    let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
    let expected = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    let wrong = profile(1_000_000_001)?;
    let before = (charge.g(), charge.p());
    let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
        super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
        wrong,
        AdmissionLimits::default(),
        &mut charge,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        result.err().ok_or("profile producer refusal")?,
        CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch
        ))
    );
    let result = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
        &expected,
        wrong,
        AdmissionLimits::default(),
        &mut charge,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        result.err().ok_or("profile verifier refusal")?,
        CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(
            PolicySchemaError::ProfileMismatch
        ))
    );
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), before);
    for maximum in [134, 135] {
        let admission = AdmissionLimits::new(1_048_576, maximum, 1_000)?;
        let before = charge.g();
        let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
            limits,
            admission,
            &mut charge,
        );
        if maximum == 134 {
            assert_eq!(
                result.err().ok_or("producer F cap")?,
                CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit)
            );
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 1_543);
        } else {
            assert_eq!(result?.as_bytes(), expected);
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 4_612);
        }
        let before = charge.g();
        let result =
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(&expected, limits, admission, &mut charge);
        if maximum == 134 {
            assert_eq!(
                result.err().ok_or("verifier F cap")?,
                CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit)
            );
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before);
        } else {
            assert_eq!(charge.g(), before + 4_423);
            assert_replace_frame_verified(
                &result?,
                &expected,
                LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
            );
        }
    }
    for case in 0..5 {
        assert_replace_frame_boundary(case, limits, &mut charge)?;
    }
    assert_replace_frame_canonical_lists(limits, &mut charge)?;
    assert_replace_frame_raw_limits(limits, &mut charge)?;
    Ok(())
}

fn complete_replace_frame_retains_each_same_account_phase_and_prior_scratch() -> TestResult {
    for producer in [false, true] {

        for (maximum, repeated, held_peak) in [

        }

        (true, 1_671, 1_543),
        (true, 2_363, 1_671),
        (true, 2_543, 2_363),
        (true, 2_806, 2_543),
        (true, 3_657, 2_806),
        (true, 4_349, 3_657),
        (true, 4_612, 4_349),
        (false, 1_673, 1_543),
        (false, 1_853, 1_673),
        (false, 2_045, 1_853),
        (false, 2_173, 2_045),
        (false, 2_301, 2_173),
        (false, 2_430, 2_301),
        (false, 2_559, 2_430),
        (false, 2_688, 2_559),
        (false, 2_817, 2_688),
        (false, 2_945, 2_817),
        (false, 3_478, 2_945),
        (false, 3_627, 3_478),
        (false, 4_160, 3_627),
        (false, 4_423, 4_160),
    ] {
        let maximum = target - 1;
        let limits = profile(maximum)?;
        let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
        let expected = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[0].0)?;
        let result = if producer {
            prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|_| ())
        } else {
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &expected,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|_| ())
        };
        assert_eq!(
            result,
            Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(
                CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                    bytes: target,
                    maximum
                })
            ))
        );
        assert_eq!(
            (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),

        );
    }
    let limits = profile(1_543)?;

    let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
        super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
        limits,
        AdmissionLimits::new(1_048_576, 134, 1_000)?,
        &mut charge,
    );
    assert_eq!(
        result.err().ok_or("F cap before Q")?,
        CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit)
    );
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (1_543, 0));
    Ok(())
}

//! Typed fixture edits and per-list canonicality controls.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;

use wf_domain::policy::RetryOverride;
use wf_domain::policy::complete::{
    ApprovalsData, AuditData, CompletePolicyData, CompletePolicyEncodingError,
    CompletePolicyReplaceInput, CompletePolicyRequestError, DenialAuditMode, EffectsData,
    GovernanceData, GovernanceMode, PolicySchemaCharge, PolicySchemaError, PolicySchemaLimits,
};
use wf_domain::policy::definition::{PolicyVersion, StateMode};
use wf_domain::retention::RetentionOverride;
use wf_domain::workflow::active::LimitEnforcement;
use wf_domain::workflow::admission::AdmissionLimits;
use wf_domain::workflow::request::RequestScope;
use wf_ports::log::{prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame, verify_complete_policy_replace_frame};
use wf_types::identity::{GroupId, RecoveryId, RequestId, TenantId};
use wf_types::version::{CommittedTime, HlcTimestamp};

use super::super::{PRESENT_INTENT_BYTES, TestResult, minimal_data, present_data, profile};
use super::literals::{assert_replace_frame_list_order, replace_frame_literal};

pub(super) fn replace_frame_input(
    data: CompletePolicyData,
    guard: Option<u64>,
    ids: [&[u8]; 4],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
) -> TestResult<CompletePolicyReplaceInput> {
    Ok(CompletePolicyReplaceInput::new(
        RequestScope::new(
            TenantId::new(ids[0].to_vec())?,
            GroupId::new(ids[1].to_vec())?,
            RecoveryId::new(ids[2].to_vec())?,
        ),
        RequestId::new(ids[3].to_vec())?,
        stamp,
        guard,
        data,
    ))
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_empty_field(
    data: &mut CompletePolicyData,
    case: usize,
    present: bool,
) -> TestResult {
    let retry = data.retry.as_mut().ok_or("retry fixture")?;
    let state = data
        .states
        .get_mut(b"s".as_slice())
        .ok_or("state fixture")?;
    let governance = data.governance.as_mut().ok_or("governance fixture")?;
    let effects = governance.effects.as_mut().ok_or("effects fixture")?;
    let approvals = governance.approvals.as_mut().ok_or("approvals fixture")?;
    match case {
        0 => data.version = present.then(|| PolicyVersion::Bytes(Vec::new())),
        1 => retry.exhausted_to = present.then(Vec::new),
        2 => data.indexed_state_meta = present.then(Vec::new),
        3 => {
            governance
                .budgets
                .as_mut()
                .and_then(|rules| rules.get_mut(b"b".as_slice()))
                .ok_or("budget fixture")?
                .unit = present.then(Vec::new)
        }
        4 => data.indexed_attributes = present.then(Vec::new),
        5 => effects.allowed = present.then(Vec::new),
        6 => effects.denied = present.then(Vec::new),
        7 => {
            governance
                .circuits
                .as_mut()
                .and_then(|rules| rules.get_mut(b"c".as_slice()))
                .ok_or("circuit fixture")?
                .error_classes = present.then(Vec::new)
        }
        8 => approvals.effects = present.then(Vec::new),
        9 => approvals.states = present.then(Vec::new),
        10 => approvals.assignees = present.then(Vec::new),
        11 => governance.limits = present.then(BTreeMap::new),
        12 => governance.budgets = present.then(BTreeMap::new),
        13 => governance.circuits = present.then(BTreeMap::new),
        14 => {
            governance.effects = present.then_some(EffectsData {
                allowed: None,
                denied: None,
                require_idempotency_key: None,
            })
        }
        15 => {
            governance.audit = present.then_some(AuditData {
                effect_events: None,
                denials: None,
            })
        }
        16 => {
            governance.approvals = present.then_some(ApprovalsData {
                effects: None,
                states: None,
                assignees: None,
                timeout_ms: None,
            })
        }
        17 => state.retry = present.then(RetryOverride::default),
        18 => state.retention = present.then(RetentionOverride::default),
        19 => {
            state.governance = if present {
                state.governance.take()
            } else {
                None
            }
        }
        20 => data.retry = present.then(RetryOverride::default),
        21 => data.retention = present.then(RetentionOverride::default),
        22 => {
            data.governance = present.then_some(GovernanceData {
                mode: None,
                effects: None,
                audit: None,
                limits: None,
                budgets: None,
                circuits: None,
                approvals: None,
            })
        }
        _ => return Err("unknown independent presence fixture".into()),
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_widths(data: &mut CompletePolicyData, maximum: bool) -> TestResult {
    let scalar = if maximum { u64::MAX } else { 0 };
    data.version = Some(PolicyVersion::Number(scalar));
    data.max_active_ms = Some(scalar);
    let retry = data.retry.as_mut().ok_or("retry fixture")?;
    retry.max_retries = Some(if maximum { u16::MAX } else { 0 });
    let backoff = retry.backoff.as_mut().ok_or("backoff fixture")?;
    backoff.base_ms = scalar;
    backoff.max_ms = scalar;
    backoff.jitter_pct = if maximum { 255 } else { 0 };
    data.retention = Some(RetentionOverride {
        ttl_ms: Some(scalar),
        history_max_events: Some(if maximum { u32::MAX } else { 0 }),
    });
    let state = data
        .states
        .get_mut(b"s".as_slice())
        .ok_or("state fixture")?;
    state.mode = Some(if maximum {
        StateMode::Fifo
    } else {
        StateMode::Parallel
    });
    state.retention = data.retention;
    let governance = data.governance.as_mut().ok_or("governance fixture")?;
    governance
        .effects
        .as_mut()
        .ok_or("effects fixture")?
        .require_idempotency_key = Some(maximum);
    governance.mode = Some(if maximum {
        GovernanceMode::Full
    } else {
        GovernanceMode::Minimal
    });
    governance.audit = Some(AuditData {
        effect_events: Some(maximum),
        denials: Some(if maximum {
            DenialAuditMode::All
        } else {
            DenialAuditMode::Off
        }),
    });
    let limit = governance

        9 => {

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_duplicate_priority() -> TestResult {
    for (maximum, frame_cap, expected_g, expected_p, error) in [
        (
            2_967,
            149,
            2_839,
            128,
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed,
        ),
        (
            2_966,
            149,
            2_710,
            128,
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                bytes: 2_967,
                maximum: 2_966,
            }),
        ),
        (2_325, 148, 2_325, 0, CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit),
        (
            2_708,
            149,
            2_453,
            0,
            CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                bytes: 2_709,
                maximum: 2_708,
            }),
        ),
    ] {
        let limits = profile(maximum)?;
        let mut charge = PolicySchemaCharge::new(limits);
        let mut data = minimal_data();
        data.indexed_attributes = Some(vec![b"a".to_vec(), b"a".to_vec()]);
        let result = prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            super::super::input(data, None)?,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::new(1_048_576, frame_cap, 1_000)?,
            &mut charge,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            result.err().ok_or("exact duplicate priority")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(error)
        );
        assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (expected_g, expected_p));
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_hex(hex: &str) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    for pair in hex.as_bytes().as_chunks::<2>().0 {
        bytes.push(u8::from_str_radix(std::str::from_utf8(pair)?, 16)?);
    }
    assert_eq!(bytes.len() * 2, hex.len());
    Ok(bytes)
}

pub(super) fn replace_frame_literal(
    intent: &[u8],
    ids: [&[u8]; 4],
    stamp: CommittedTime,
) -> TestResult<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut expected = b"FWCP\0\x01\x06".to_vec();
    for id in ids {
        expected.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(id.len())?.to_be_bytes());
        expected.extend_from_slice(id);
    }
    expected.extend_from_slice(b"\0\x02");
    expected.extend_from_slice(&<[u8; 32]>::from(Sha256::digest(intent)));
    expected.extend_from_slice(&stamp.hlc().physical().get().to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&stamp.hlc().logical().to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&stamp.wall().get().to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(&u32::try_from(intent.len())?.to_be_bytes());
    expected.extend_from_slice(intent);
    Ok(expected)
}

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_verified(
    verified: &VerifiedCompletePolicyReplaceFrame<'_>,
    expected: &[u8],
    log: LogIdentity,
) {
    let mut cursor = 7;
    let mut ids = Vec::new();
    let mut scope = b"FWSC\0\x01".to_vec();
    for index in 0..4 {
        assert_eq!(&expected[cursor..cursor + 2], &[0, 0]);
        let length = usize::from(u16::from_be_bytes(
            expected[cursor + 2..cursor + 4].as_chunks::<2>().0[0],
        ));
        if index < 3 {
            scope.extend_from_slice(&expected[cursor..cursor + 4]);
        }
        cursor += 4;
        ids.push(&expected[cursor..cursor + length]);
        if index < 3 {
            scope.extend_from_slice(ids[index]);
        }
        cursor += length;
    }
    let original = &expected[cursor + 56..];
    let digest = PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(expected).into());
    let intent: [u8; 32] = Sha256::digest(original).into();
    let physical = u64::from_be_bytes(expected[cursor + 34..cursor + 42].as_chunks::<8>().0[0]);
    let logical = u16::from_be_bytes(expected[cursor + 42..cursor + 44].as_chunks::<2>().0[0]);
    let wall = u64::from_be_bytes(expected[cursor + 44..cursor + 52].as_chunks::<8>().0[0]);
    let header = verified.header(log);
    assert_eq!(verified.encoded(), expected);
    assert_eq!(verified.original_intent(), original);
    assert_eq!(verified.digest(), digest);
    assert_eq!(verified.isolation_scope(), scope);
    assert_eq!(header.format_version, 1);
    assert_eq!(header.scope.tenant().as_bytes(), ids[0]);
    assert_eq!(header.scope.group().as_bytes(), ids[1]);
    assert_eq!(header.scope.recovery().as_bytes(), ids[2]);
    assert_eq!(header.request.as_bytes(), ids[3]);
    assert_eq!(header.intent.version(), 2);
    assert_eq!(*header.intent.digest(), intent);
    assert_eq!(header.stamp.hlc().physical().get(), physical);
    assert_eq!(header.stamp.hlc().logical(), logical);
    assert_eq!(header.stamp.wall().get(), wall);
    assert_eq!(header.identity, EntryIdentity::new(log, digest));
    assert_eq!(header.encoded_entry, expected);
    assert_eq!(header.encoded_isolation_scope, scope);
}

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_account(
    maximum: u64,

) -> TestResult {

    };

    let mut produced = Vec::new();
    let mut verified = Vec::new();
    let fee = if producer { 4_612 } else { 4_423 };
    let attempts = if repeated { 2 } else { 1 };
    let initial = if held_peak { 1_928 } else { 0 };
    let peak = if held_peak { 64 } else { 0 };
    assert_eq!((charge.g(), charge.p()), (initial, peak));
    for attempt in 1..=attempts {
        let target = initial + fee * attempt + peak;
        let result = if producer {
            prepare_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                super::super::input(minimal_data(), None)?,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                &mut charge,
            )
            .map(|value| produced.push(value))
        } else {
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(

                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),

            )

        };
        if maximum < target {
            assert_eq!(
                result,
                Err(CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(
                    CompletePolicyEncodingError::Schema(PolicySchemaError::WorkBytes {
                        bytes: target,
                        maximum
                    })
                ))
            );
            assert_eq!(
                (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
                (target - peak - 263, peak, target - 263)
            );
        } else {
            result?;
            assert_eq!(
                (charge.g(), charge.p(), charge.total()),
                (target - peak, peak, target)
            );
        }
    }
    for value in &produced {
        assert_eq!(value.as_bytes(), expected);
        assert_eq!(
            value.digest(),
            PreparedDigest::new(Sha256::digest(&expected).into())
        );
    }
    for value in &verified {
        assert_replace_frame_verified(
            value,
            &expected,
            LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
        );
    }
    if let Some(seed) = seed {
        let mut expected = minimal_data();
        expected.indexed_attributes = Some(vec![b"a".to_vec()]);
        assert!(seed.data() == &expected);
        assert_eq!(seed.generation(), 1);
    }
    assert_eq!(charge.p(), peak);
    Ok(())
}

    assert_eq!(
        verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(&bytes, limits, AdmissionLimits::default(), charge)
            .err()
            .ok_or("digest mismatch")?,
        CompletePolicyRequestError::IntentMismatch

    for (declared, error) in [
        (51_u32, CompletePolicyEncodingError::TrailingBytes),
        (53, CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed),
        (1_048_577, CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit),
    ] {
        let mut bytes = minimum.clone();

pub(super) fn assert_replace_frame_tags(
    limits: PolicySchemaLimits,
    charge: &mut PolicySchemaCharge,
) -> TestResult {
    let minimum = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[0].0)?;
    for (offset, value, error) in [
        (0, b'X', CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed),
        (5, 2, CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion),
        (6, 5, CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag),
        (28, 1, CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedVersion),
        (83, b'X', CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed),
        (118, 2, CompletePolicyEncodingError::InvalidOptionality),
        (124, 2, CompletePolicyEncodingError::InvalidOptionality),
    ] {
        let mut bytes = minimum.clone();
        bytes[offset] = value;
        let result = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
            &bytes,
            limits,
            AdmissionLimits::default(),
            charge,
        );
        assert_eq!(
            result.err().ok_or("malformed mutation")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(error)
        );
    }
    let mut full = replace_frame_hex(FROZEN_COMPLETE_REPLACE_FRAMES[1].0)?;
    for (offset, value) in [
        (42, 2),
        (65, 4),
        (114, 2),
        (165, 3),
        (188, 2),
        (191, 2),
        (193, 3),
        (213, 2),
        (250, 2),
    ] {
        let previous = full[83 + offset];
        full[83 + offset] = value;
        let result =
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(&full, limits, AdmissionLimits::default(), charge);
        assert_eq!(
            result.err().ok_or("enum precedes stale digest")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::UnsupportedTag)
        );
        full[83 + offset] = previous;
    }
    for start in [61, 71] {
        let mut bytes = minimum.clone();
        bytes[start..start + 8].copy_from_slice(&u64::MAX.to_be_bytes());
        assert_eq!(
            verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &bytes,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge
            )
            .err()
            .ok_or("invalid trusted stamp")?,
            CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::Malformed)
        );
    }
    let stamp = CommittedTime::new(HlcTimestamp::new(0, 0)?, 0)?;
    for field in 1..4 {
        for length in [256, 257] {
            let id = vec![b'x'; length];
            let mut ids = [&b"t"[..], &b"g"[..], &b"r"[..], &b"q"[..]];
            ids[field] = &id;
            let expected = replace_frame_literal(MINIMAL_INTENT_BYTES, ids, stamp)?;
            let result = verify_complete_policy_replace_frame(
                &expected,
                limits,
                AdmissionLimits::default(),
                charge,
            );
            if length == 257 {
                assert_eq!(
                    result.err().ok_or("ID RAW +1")?,
                    CompletePolicyRequestError::Encoding(CompletePolicyEncodingError::ByteLimit)
                );
            } else {
                assert_replace_frame_verified(
                    &result?,
                    &expected,
                    LogIdentity::new(1, 2, AppliedPosition::new(3)),
                );
            }
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
